promptFull: Create a photoreal, grounded 30-second action movie scene, live action, not animation. A 32-year-old female courier with short dark hair, an olive raincoat and a narrow leather satchel races through a rain-soaked European city at blue hour to deliver a small silver data case. Keep her face, coat and satchel consistent throughout. Story in five visually clear beats: (0-5s) extreme close-up of her hand locking the silver case into the satchel; she hears approaching footsteps and looks up, fear held in her eyes. (5-11s) a wide practical rooftop shot as she runs across slick tiles while two distant pursuers emerge from a stairwell, no weapons. (11-18s) tracking camera close beside her as she ducks under a clothesline, slips, catches a railing, recovers; physical effort and wet fabric feel real. (18-25s) she makes one believable short jump onto an adjacent fire escape, lands heavily, almost loses the satchel and grabs it. (25-30s) she stops at a lit apartment window, sees the person waiting inside and holds up the case; a genuine emotional beat of relief. Realistic scale, no superhero movement, no impossible acrobatics. Cinematography: premium theatrical spy thriller, 35 mm anamorphic lens, natural skin texture, practical rain and sodium-vapor streetlight mixed with cool dusk, deep layered city background, controlled handheld movement, elegant high contrast color grade, 24 fps film motion. Careful spatial continuity across edits. No gore, blood, violence, weapons, text, captions, logos, fake interface, or lip-synced speech. Sound may contain rain, breathing, footfalls and a restrained cinematic pulse, but no spoken dialogue; dialogue will be added in postproduction.
